title: 空席が消えた朝
change: 帰還食堂へ攻略者が仲間を連れて戻り、十六食を売り切る。翌日の予約と実際の代金を得る。
state: 一営業日の十六食は自給と仕入れの合計。全48m²の安定収穫ではない。ロウは第9話の十二食を食べた攻略者の一人。店は混雑したが注文を断り分け、無限に追加調理しない。収入は費用を引く前の売上。

sources.description: Early morning at the same blue-awning diner. Broad quiet establishing empty tables, Elna ties her apron; narrow closeup Kou straightens clean bowls. Below, two close uneven panels: Kou hears footsteps on the left paved lane then looks towards the doorway. Do NOT reveal the arriving crowd yet.
dialogue:
今日は
何人来るかな

昨日の分は
用意できてる
sources.scrollPurpose: 足音だけを先に届けて来客を待たせる

sources.description: Reveal the returning customers only here. Row is a capable male adventurer age30 with short rust-auburn hair, ochre cloak, leather cuirass and sheathed steel sword, unlike silver-haired Leon. He stands at the lane doorway with two adult teammates. Row smiles remembering the prior meal; Elna recognizes him; separate reaction of Kou, no food served yet.
dialogue:
ここだ
俺たちの飯を
作ってくれた店

今日は
仲間も連れてきた
sources.scrollPurpose: 前の納品が新しい客を呼んだことを見せる

sources.description: The same lane a little later, not another city. Kou steps outside carrying an empty wooden order board, sees several small groups gathering under the blue awning. Large borderless reveal of a modest but obvious queue of about10 adults, then Elna startled closeup, then a gray-haired ordinary customer asking politely. Do not draw 100people or a royal parade.
dialogue:
ここの定食が
うまいって
聞いてきた

順番に
案内します

俺だけの店には
できなかったな
sources.scrollPurpose: 空席だった店と行列の差を大きく披露する

sources.description: Inside the same compact diner kitchen. Elna with clean hands portions simmered stew into ceramic shallow bowls; Kou checks sixteen serving tokens in two short rows of8 on a separate clean service shelf, NOT a notebook on food. Meat and barley purchased, leaf greens partly harvested. Short paired ladle and serving-hand closeups, broader teamwork, guests still waiting.
dialogue:
今日は
十六食まで

うん
一皿ずつ
ちゃんと出そう
sources.scrollPurpose: 数と手順を守りながら素早く食事へつなぐ

sources.description: Heroic appetizing food reveal in warm afternoon diner light. One large borderless glazed beef carrot leaf-green barley stew in ivory ceramic bowl, smooth rich russet-brown gravy, tender beef chunks and carrot cross-sections, soft green leaves, steam rises through sparse cream area. Small top hand places bowl, then dish takes most of scroll; an adjacent simple piece of bread. NO customer mouth, bite or reaction yet. No beadlike grain texture. Bottom tiny spoon about to lift but does not touch mouth.
dialogue:
お腹いっぱい
食べてね
sources.scrollPurpose: 湯気と料理を味わい食べた反応は下へ残す

sources.description: Same Row sits at wooden table, same ceramic stew and bread. First spoon lifts a realistic small beef and carrot bite, next Row eats, quiet widened eyes separate, then a big relieved smile and shoulders relaxing. Adult teammate only at edge, never Leon. Finally Row looks toward Elna and Kou at counter. Food quantity decreases after bite, spoon not doubled.
dialogue:
戦いのあとに
欲しかったのは
こういう飯だ

帰ってくる理由が
増えたな

次も
ここにしよう
sources.scrollPurpose: ひと口から驚きと指名までを受け止める

sources.description: Late afternoon, used empty ceramic bowls collected apart from clean counter. Elna receives last customer copper coins; later counts sales with Kou at dry ledger desk, no money beside cooking food. Ledger abstract marks only. First show empty serving-pot and all16tokens turned over, then copper coin stacks, Elna stunned delighted face. Meal price6copper, total gross96copper, not net profit.
dialogue:
売上は
九十六銅貨

仕入れと費用は
ここから払う

それでも
全部選んでもらえた
sources.scrollPurpose: 売り切れと代金を具体的な報酬として見せる

sources.description: Quiet evening at clean empty diner, warm lamps, no crowd now. Row at doorway gives a small blank paper reservation token to Elna, no actual inscription; closeup Elna holds it then Kou looks at now-empty chairs with happy disbelief, final large shared smile. No next-floor journey, new crops or new contract yet. Sparse ivory ending with rising warm lamp glow.
dialogue:
明日の分も
取っておいてくれ

また来て
くれるんだ

俺たちの仕事が
帰ってきたな

明日も
この店を開けよう
sources.scrollPurpose: 次の来店の約束と二人の喜びに余韻を残す
